en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small town in a wide valley with mountains in the background. The foreground shows tightly clustered tiled-roof houses, while more scattered buildings and cultivated fields stretch toward the base of the mountains. A church with a bell tower stands out near the center-right. The caption beneath the image identifies the location as Mattarello, near Trento, and labels the view as a panorama.
